name: @open-studio/agent-sidecar
description: Open Studio AI agent sidecar — embeds the pi coding agent (pi-agent-core) and speaks newline-delimited JSON over stdio with the Python backend.
// build 的 --ignore-annotations: pi-ai 的 package.json 把 sideEffects 限定在三个文件里,于是 esbuild 认为 models.js 等模块
「无副作用」,把它们的初始化摘掉/推迟 —— 而 createModels() 会被提到顶层,它引用的
ModelsImpl 却留在惰性块里,调用时是 undefined,每轮对话都报 is not a constructor。
--ignore-annotations 让 esbuild 忽略 sideEffects/__PURE__ 标注,初始化顺序即被固定。
删掉它会静默复现该故障:类型与单测全绿,只有 test:bundle 抓得到。

scripts.test: node test/subagent-report.test.mjs && node test/subagent-manager.test.mjs && node test/usage.test.mjs && node test/compaction.test.mjs && node test/context-meter.parity.test.mjs && node test/credentials.test.mjs && node test/proxy.test.mjs && node test/thinking.test.mjs && node test/thinking-wire.test.mjs && node test/bundle.smoke.mjs
